text_block_list.text:
The day of the spring Tenno Sho<n>arrives. Among
the competitors is<n>Mejiro McQueen, set on winning
the<n>race for the third consecutive year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower heads to the starting<n>gates of this
grand race, hoping to<n>make a miracle happen.
